name: awaken-hunter-system
description: Awaken - a System-style daily training app: 10-minute boxing, Muay Thai, knife and stick drills plus push-up/squat/crunch levels.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease assembleRelease
